name: The Coffin of Candy Scabs
source:
Andrew and Ashley are still in the second month of quarantine, and its the Halloween. However, this Halloween was turned on its head when two mysterious new 'people' suddenly appeared in their living room!

[From NexusMods]
translation:
安德鲁和阿什利仍处于隔离的第二个月，今天是万圣节。然而，这个万圣节却发生了翻天覆地的变化，两个神秘的新“人”突然出现在他们的客厅里！

[来自NexusMods]
